title: Outport
text: Create output port for subsystem or external output, 1 input, no direct feedthrough, {Port dimensions (-1 for inherited)} sets Port dimensions; {Port number} sets the position of port on parent block, {Signal name}, {Icon display}, {Specify output when source is unconnected} sets the unconnected output value, {Constant value} sets the output value when the block is not, {Interpret vector parameters as 1-D} treats vectors as 1-D, {Ensure outport is virtual} sets the ensure that outport is virtual, {Output when disabled}, {Initial output}, {Minimum}, {Maximum}, {Data type} sets the output data type Inherit, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Output as nonvirtual bus in parent model}, {Unit (e.g., m, m/s^2, N*m)} sets the physical unit of the input signal to the block, {Variable-size signal} allows variable-size signals, {Signal type} sets the output signal type and {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the option to specify sample time. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Port number
params.values: Position of port on parent block 1 (default) | real integer

params.name: Icon display
params.values: Icon display Port number (default) | Signal name | Port number and signal name

params.name: Specify output when source is unconnected
params.values: Specify unconnected output value off (default) | on

params.name: Constant value
params.values: Output value when the block is not connected 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Ensure outport is virtual
params.values: Ensure that outport is virtual off (default) | on

params.name: Initial output
params.values: Initial output for conditionally executed subsystems [] (default) | scalar | structure

params.name: Data type
params.values: Output data type Inherit: auto (default) | double | single | half | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 |...

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on

params.name: Output as nonvirtual bus in parent model
params.values: Output as nonvirtual bus in parent model off (default) | on

params.name: Unit (e.g., m, m/s^2, N*m)
params.values: Physical unit of the input signal to the block inherit (default) | <Enter unit>

params.name: Variable-size signal
params.values: Allow variable-size signals Inherit (default) | No | Yes

params.name: Signal type
params.values: Output signal type auto (default) | real | complex

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: Option to specify sample time -1 (default) | scalar
